name: PRE_WAR_PREPARATION
definition: Tempest fixes its order of battle and reorganises into two wings (V12 Ch2). Placement RECONSTRUCTED: only the narrative order (before V12 Ch4) is canonical.

name: IMPERIAL_DECISION_AND_MOBILIZATION
definition: Imperial council and war decree, legion taskings. That evening Rudra and Velgrynd hear that the Great March is decided (V12 Ch4, Epilogue).

name: APPROACH_MARCH
definition: The 900,000 main formation leaves the capital 'the next day' (V12 Epilogue) with the 70,000 reinforcement cohort in its column (970,000), masses at the border base (D-34) and advances slowly while Tempest holds its war council (the 'gathering', R0 = D-33). The Tempest border is crossed on D-24. The 30,000 eastern cohort leaves on D-11 by the isthmus road and enters Dwargon on D-5: Dwargon is at war from then (scenario).

name: HALT_AND_DEPLOYMENT
definition: 'Soon after' the month mark the 970,000 halt at the forest edge as the eastern cohort reaches Dwargon's Eastern Gate (D-3 14:00). The main formation splits: 700,000 march on the Tempest capital and 200,000 on Dwargon's Main Gate through its south-western border. The 70,000 cohort stays staged. Testarossa's group reaches the Main Gate on D-1 (scenario).

name: FIRST_CONTACT_AND_SURFACE_BATTLE
definition: The 200,000 array before the Main Gate as the 700,000 camp ~30 km from the capital (D+0 08:00). Testarossa's ultimatum is rejected after hours of waiting. The cohort splits, 40,000 airships to the Main Gate (240,000 there) and 30,000 to the Eastern Gate. The Main Gate battle destroys the 240,000 in under two hours and the south-western front falls back to the pre-war line.

name: LABYRINTH_RAID
definition: Labyrinth Raider operation: 350,000 enter on day one and 200,000 on day two (scenario, the novels: 350,000 / 150,000 / 30,000), 150,000 stay outside. The 30,000 from the cohort reach the Eastern Gate (60,000 there, D+7). Minitz falls. 550,000 killed inside with no Tempest losses.

name: ANNIHILATION_OF_THE_OUTSIDE_CAMP
definition: After dawn Caligulio learns the labyrinth troops are dead. Carrera's Gravity Collapse, Geld's Second Corps and Diablo destroy the 150,000 outside. Caligulio killed. Jura front: 700,000 killed. The ground around the capital returns to Tempest.

name: RESURRECTION_AND_CONSOLIDATION
definition: Resurrection of ~700,000 (D+11), held as prisoners. Rewards and evolution (D+12). Prisoners calm (D+13). Yuuki prepares the coup. Tempest's First Corps marches east to join Gazel at the Eastern Gate (scenario).

name: LONG_NIGHT
definition: The single long night from the evening of D+15: the allied counter-offensive pushes east from the Eastern Gate against the 60,000. Miranda killed and the coup crushed in Tidu. Velgrynd destroys the 60,000. The Third Strike (10,100) leaves the capital reserve, most for the Eastern Gate, the rest for the Tempest capital (scenario). Dwargon eastern front. Rimuru's party trapped. Dragon battle and Veldora's domination. Magic Beast Division destroyed. Both Third Strike groups destroyed. Flagship battles. Michael and Feldway withdraw. Both fronts back on the pre-war line.

name: POST_WAR_INTERVAL
definition: Officers take a day off. The capital returns to the surface. Rimuru interviews his subordinates. No fighting.

name: SUMMIT_AND_SETTLEMENT
definition: Three-nation summit: end-of-war agreement, Masayuki to be named emperor by Velgrynd, no war-crimes trials, prisoners to be released, reconstruction, Testarossa to open an embassy. Zamdo restored at the lunch break. Gazel leaves the next morning.

name: REPATRIATION_PREPARATION
definition: Caligulio prepares to march the resurrected prisoners home. They leave within the week (D+26 RECONSTRUCTED). Days later Guy Crimson summons an emergency Walpurgis Council of the Octagram (D+27 RECONSTRUCTED).
